title: Google Search Growth for ‘Near Me’ Queries
takeaway: Google Search for ‘near me’ queries has grown dramatically over the past few years.

data.evidence: A staggering 40% of all Google searches include a ‘near me’ element.
Recent studies show that nearly 50% of all Google searches now include a ‘near me’ query.
‘Near me’ searches have grown by over 90% in the last few years.

narration: The popularity of ‘near me’ searches has exploded in recent years, representing a significant opportunity for local businesses.  Initial research in 2019 indicated 40% of Google searches included a ‘near me’ element, while more recent studies show this figure has climbed to nearly 50% by 2023.  This substantial growth underscores the importance of optimizing for local search.
